answer: Work waits on the horizon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the spiral of the next round. The reef of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, slashed on a failed audit. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
